source_document.body:
Walmart opened a fulfillment center in Stockton, California, adding more than 900,000 square feet of space to handle online orders for West Coast customers. The facility is expected to create more than 1,000 jobs and is the retailer ’s fifth next-generation fulfillment center.
What’s Related
The building uses automation and machine learning to store merchandise and move orders through the facility. Walmart says the technology allows it to hold more inventory and fill more orders each day than a traditional fulfillment center.
Located in California’s Central Valley, the facility puts inventory closer to customers across California and the West Coast. Walmart said it will help expand faster shipping options on millions of items, and hiring is continuing as operations ramp up.
The site will also handle orders for third-party Marketplace sellers through Walmart Fulfillment Services. Walmart first announced the Stockton project in October 2023.
RELATED STORIES: Walmart Ranks Third in 2026 Top 25 Supply Chain Rankings | Walmart to Pay Drivers $100 Million in Settlement Over Misleading Pay
From 12 steps to five
The Stockton facility uses an automated storage and retrieval system that brings products directly to workers. Walmart says it reduces its traditional 12-step fulfillment process to five steps while cutting repetitive manual tasks.
In Walmart’s previously published description of that system, the five steps are unloading, receiving, picking , packing and shipping. Workers unload cases onto conveyors , then place individual products into totes that move into automated storage.
When an order comes in, the system retrieves the needed totes and sends them to a worker’s picking station. A box is made to fit the order, and completed packages are automatically taped, labeled and routed for shipping.
Walmart developed the system with warehouse automation company Knapp. It tested the technology at its Pedricktown, New Jersey, fulfillment center before announcing the next-generation facilities in 2022.
Earlier plans called for twice the daily orders
When Walmart announced the Stockton project in 2023, it said the technology would double storage space and the number of customer orders it could fill each day compared with its traditional approach. The opening announcement says storage and daily order handling will increase, but does not provide a Stockton-specific daily order target.
Walmart says these facilities, combined with its other fulfillment centers, will allow it to reach 95% of the U.S. population with next- or two-day shipping. That figure applies to the combined operation.
More Walmart news
ShipStation Adds Walmart Shipping Rates : ShipStation launched Ship with Walmart, giving U.S. Marketplace sellers access to Walmart -negotiated shipping rates and seller protections within the platform.
Walmart Plans $1.3 Billion Georgia Fulfillment Center : Walmart plans to build an automated fulfillment center in Carnesville, Georgia, creating 1,000 jobs .
Walmart Expands Delivery to Dunkin’ Restaurants : Walmart plans to offer delivery from a majority of Dunkin’s 10,000 U.S. restaurants through its app and website.
